verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU. Configuring background automations is a software-agent capability, so the story is a category error for this kind of product. The docs' line about 'running autonomous AI agents locally' describes compute capacity for third-party software, not an automation feature the card itself ships, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
